archimate:ApplicationInterface.name: treasury reconciliation
archimate:ApplicationInterface.documentation: Cash, Liquidity & Treasury Reconciliation Direction: Bi-directional (Aladdin ⟷ ERP Treasury) Payload: Aladdin to ERP: Settled investment cash, trade settlement obligations, collateral movements, and projected cash flows from coupons or debt maturities. ERP to Aladdin: Swept cash balances, central bank accounts, non-investment corporate cash, or debt issuance proceeds available for deployment.
